name: career advice for 2026 and beyond
description: A young adult asks about in-demand jobs in 2026, career trends, and whether it is too late to change careers at 35. Verifies the career_2026 fact (skills-based hiring, AI reshaping roles, growing fields in tech, healthcare, trades, and creative work) and the career_switch fact for mid-career pivots.

turns.text: What jobs will be in demand in 2026?
Is it too late to change careers at 35?

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: the in-demand jobs question returns the career_2026 numbered list of growing fields. Turn 2: career trends for 2026 matches the same fact. Turn 3: the mid-career change question returns the career_switch fact (transferable skills, research, gradual shift, no comparison).
expected.behavior: Career guidance reflects the 2026 reality: skills-based hiring over degrees, AI reshaping rather than erasing roles, and growing demand in healthcare, skilled trades, tech, and creative-digital fields. Mid-career pivots are framed as a process, not a deadline.
